features.note: No regression from attempt 2: three distinct blade volumes read across both views, and the new dark edge lips SHARPEN blade separation rather than merging them. Top blade presents its lit upper face tipped toward the viewer (+theta) with a dark leading-edge lip; the drive blade below shows the opposite slant with its own dark edge band, so counter-rotation still reads mid-travel. Bottom blade remains the weakest read (foreshortened strips near the sill) but is confirmed in both views.

Improved over attempt 2: the plated spindle still protrudes from the frame right face across a clear air gap (proportion consistent with >=37 mm free spindle) with a dark clamp collar where it enters the orange body, and the anti-rotation strap NOW reads as its own flat plate from the actuator underside to the frame face, no longer visually merged with the lower bearing end. Definitively not flush-mounted.

Held from attempt 2: light circular dial-plate block with a dark pointer needle on the actuator's outboard face reads clearly in the spec view. Printed 0-90 arc is not expected at blockout; 1:1 rotation cannot be verified from stills — judged on pointer + dial blocking, both present.
No regression: both views show the channel casing with real depth (~127 mm proportion vs the 600x400 face), separated flange planes on both faces, and corner tabs.

Held from attempt 2: the -35 deg orbit view shows the plated vertical tie rod with three dark crank blocks on the left axle ends on the non-actuator side. Coherent motion cannot be verified from a still; decomposition and placement are correct.

important_features.note: Attempt-2 failure resolved: thin near-black edge strips now read along the meeting edges of all three blades in BOTH views (top-blade leading-edge lip, double dark band under the drive blade, sill-line strips at the bottom blade), plus a dark head strip and dark interior side faces at the jambs. The jamb strips are the softest part of the read — they partly blend into the shadowed reveal — which caps the score at 0.7 rather than higher.
Held from attempt 2: flat white label-plate block visible on the orange actuator body in both views; printed text not expected at blockout.
Held from attempt 2: cable leaves the gland and droops with a visible multi-segment curve — pronounced S-curve in the orbit view, gentler but still curved in the spec view; not a straight rod.

defects: Jamb/head seal strips partly blend into the dark shadowed reveal of the opening; they read as a dark interior rather than unmistakably discrete strips — make them discrete proud strips at the materials pass.
Bottom blade remains the weakest of the three: a narrow foreshortened strip near the sill in both views (present, but low visual weight).
Dial plate still has no 0-90 arc marking (acceptable at blockout; carry to the materials pass).
Cable droop in the spec view is subtle; the catenary only reads strongly in the orbit view.
Mechanical: draws=0 is an N/A placeholder — blender track has no draw-call probe; do not read it as a real draw count.
